# KW Commercial Texas

> KW Commercial Texas is a Houston-based commercial real estate brokerage and the commercial division of KW Memorial, part of KW Commercial. 1220 Augusta Drive, Suite 300, Houston, TX 77057; 713.470.2100; kwmcommercialtx@gmail.com.

Key facts:
- Founded in 2008; Houston's largest KW Commercial office, #1 in volume and agent count.
- Clients get one advisor for business property and a Houston home, working with the office's luxury and international specialists; clients have access to KW's referral network of 165,000+ agents across 55+ regions.
- KW Commercial Texas professionals serve on National Association of REALTORS®, Texas REALTORS® and Houston Association of REALTORS® committees.
- KW Commercial Texas hosts a monthly Property Information Exchange where brokers from across Houston share commercial opportunities.
- Agents can promote listings with marketing videos from the office's in-house Content Lab studio.
- Services: sales and leasing representation for owners and landlords, acquisitions for investors, site selection for businesses and tenants, development evaluation, business brokerage, pricing and valuation guidance (broker opinions of value), market reports prepared for clients on request.
- Property types: Retail, Office, Industrial, Multifamily, Land and development, Medical, Hospitality.
- Languages spoken by commercial agents beyond English: Arabic, Cantonese, Greek, Italian, Korean, Mandarin, Persian (Farsi), Romanian, Spanish, Vietnamese. For other languages, commercial agents partner with colleagues from the 500+ agent KW Memorial office, whose International Division includes colleagues who speak more than 40 languages.
- Connected to the world's largest real estate franchise by agent count: 165,000+ KW agents across 55+ regions, and 1,800+ KW Commercial members across North America.

## How a deal works, by property type

### Retail (https://www.kwcommercialtexas.com/property-types/houston-retail-real-estate.html)
Leasing or buying retail space: 1. Define your requirements: Size, frontage, visibility, parking, co-tenants and budget, and for restaurants, kitchen, venting and grease trap needs. 2. Site search and tours: We identify listed and off-market sites, review traffic and the surrounding trade area, and tour them with you. 3. Letter of intent: We negotiate the key terms first: rent, term, improvements, signage, exclusive use, co-tenancy and options. 4. Due diligence: Confirm permitted uses, deed restrictions, utility capacity, build-out cost and the center's operating expenses. 5. Lease or purchase and opening: Final documents are negotiated and signed, and we stay involved through build-out toward your opening.
Selling or leasing your retail center: 1. Pricing and valuation guidance: A broker opinion of value based on comparable sales, your rent roll and current market conditions. 2. Leasing or sale strategy: For leasing, the tenant mix to target; for a sale, how to position the property for investors. 3. Marketing and outreach: Listing on our search and KW Commercial's, and outreach to retailers, restaurant groups, investors and brokers. 4. Offers and negotiation: We compare proposals with you and negotiate rent, terms, price and contingencies. 5. Closing or lease signing: We coordinate tenant documents, due diligence and the closing or lease execution.

### Office (https://www.kwcommercialtexas.com/property-types/houston-office-space.html)
Leasing or buying office space: 1. Define your needs: Headcount and growth, layout, location and commute, parking, budget, and when your current lease ends. 2. Search and tour: We compare options on total cost, building quality, parking and amenities, then tour them with you. 3. Proposals and letter of intent: We negotiate rent, free rent, the improvement allowance, term and options to renew, expand or contract. 4. Space planning and due diligence: A test-fit of your layout, build-out cost estimates and a review of operating expenses. 5. Lease or purchase agreement: Final documents are negotiated and signed, then we help keep build-out and move-in on track.
Leasing or selling your office building: 1. Pricing and valuation guidance: A broker opinion of value based on comparable sales and leases and your rent roll. 2. Positioning: How to present vacant suites or the building, from layout options to the marketing package. 3. Marketing and tours: Listing on our search and KW Commercial's, and outreach to tenants, brokers and investors. 4. Negotiation: Rent, concessions and improvements for leases, or price and terms for a sale. 5. Lease signing or closing: We coordinate documents, due diligence and the lease execution or closing.

### Industrial (https://www.kwcommercialtexas.com/property-types/houston-industrial-real-estate.html)
Leasing or buying industrial space: 1. Define your requirements: Size, clear height, dock and door needs, power, office share, location and budget, plus when you need to move. 2. Search and tour: We identify listed and off-market options that fit, then tour and compare them with you. 3. Letter of intent: We negotiate the key terms in writing first: rent or price, term, improvements, options and timing. 4. Due diligence: Confirm the building works for your operation: systems, power, allowed uses, deed restrictions and flood plain status. 5. Lease or purchase agreement: Final documents are negotiated and signed, and we help you plan the move-in.
Selling or leasing your industrial building: 1. Pricing and valuation guidance: A broker opinion of value based on comparable sales and leases and current market conditions. 2. Positioning and marketing: Listing on our search and KW Commercial's, outreach to users, investors and brokers, and marketing video if you want it. 3. Tours and offers: We show the property, qualify prospects and compare offers or proposals with you. 4. Negotiation: We negotiate price or rent, terms and contingencies on your behalf. 5. Closing or lease signing: We coordinate due diligence, documents and the closing or lease execution.

### Multifamily (https://www.kwcommercialtexas.com/property-types/houston-multifamily-investment.html)
Buying multifamily property: 1. Set your criteria: Size, location, age, stabilized or value-add, budget and how you plan to finance it. 2. Find and review: We identify properties and review rent rolls, operating statements and how rents compare with the area. 3. Offer and letter of intent: Price, earnest money, the due diligence period and the closing timeline. 4. Due diligence: Unit walks and inspections, leases, actual expenses, property taxes, insurance and financing. 5. Closing: Loan, title and closing, then the hand-off to your property management.
Selling multifamily property: 1. Pricing and valuation guidance: A broker opinion of value based on income, cap rates and comparable sales. 2. Preparing the offering: Rent roll, operating statements and property information buyers will ask for. 3. Marketing to buyers: Outreach to qualified investors, 1031 exchange buyers and brokers, including across the KW network. 4. Offers and negotiation: We compare price, terms, buyer financing and certainty of closing with you. 5. Due diligence and closing: We manage buyer requests and inspections and coordinate the closing.

### Land and development (https://www.kwcommercialtexas.com/property-types/houston-commercial-land.html)
Buying land or a development site: 1. Define the project: Intended use, size, access, utilities, budget and timeline. 2. Site search: We identify listed and off-market tracts and screen them for restrictions, access and flood plain. 3. Contract with a feasibility period: Price, earnest money and enough time to confirm the site works for your project. 4. Feasibility: Survey, title, environmental review, utilities and any MUD, drainage, deed restrictions and zoning. 5. Closing: We coordinate title and closing, and connect you with the professionals your project needs next.
Selling land: 1. Pricing and valuation guidance: A broker opinion of value based on comparable sales, location, access, utilities and potential uses. 2. Best use and best buyers: We identify who will value the site most: developers, owner-users or investors. 3. Marketing: Listing on our search and KW Commercial's, and outreach to developers, builders, investors and brokers. 4. Offers and negotiation: Price, feasibility period, contingencies and closing timeline. 5. Due diligence and closing: We support the buyer's feasibility work and coordinate the closing.

### Medical (https://www.kwcommercialtexas.com/property-types/houston-medical-office.html)
Leasing or buying medical space: 1. Define your practice's needs: Patient and referral locations, exam rooms, equipment, plumbing, power, parking and accessibility. 2. Search and tour: We find medical-ready space and space that can be converted, then tour it with you. 3. Letter of intent: Rent, term, improvement allowance, permitted medical uses, signage and options. 4. Space planning and due diligence: Build-out costs, code and accessibility requirements, and utility capacity. 5. Lease or purchase agreement: Final documents are negotiated and signed, then we help keep build-out on track to your opening.
Selling or leasing your medical building: 1. Pricing and valuation guidance: A broker opinion of value based on comparable sales and leases and your tenants. 2. Positioning: Presenting the property to healthcare tenants or to investors in medical property. 3. Marketing and outreach: Listing on our search and KW Commercial's, and outreach to practices, healthcare groups, investors and brokers. 4. Negotiation: Rent, improvements and terms for leases, or price and terms for a sale. 5. Closing or lease signing: We coordinate documents, due diligence and the closing or lease execution.

### Hospitality (https://www.kwcommercialtexas.com/property-types/houston-hospitality-real-estate.html)
Buying a hotel: 1. Set your criteria: Branded or independent, size, location, budget and financing. 2. Find and review: We identify hotels and review operating history: occupancy, average daily rate and RevPAR. 3. Offer and letter of intent: Price, deposit, the due diligence period and franchise approval timing. 4. Due diligence: Financial statements, property condition, the franchise agreement and any required renovations, staff, and furniture and equipment. 5. Franchise approval and closing: We coordinate brand approval, financing and the closing.
Selling a hotel: 1. Pricing and valuation guidance: A broker opinion of value based on operating performance, brand and condition. 2. Preparing the offering: Financial statements, renovation status and franchise terms buyers will review. 3. Marketing to qualified buyers: Outreach to operators, investors and brokers, including KW agents abroad who work with international buyers. 4. Offers and negotiation: We compare price, terms, buyer experience and certainty of closing with you. 5. Due diligence and closing: We manage buyer requests, the franchise transfer or exit, and the closing.
